doc.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Charlie Parker was not crazy
summary: He says Parker was reserved, well spoken and brilliant.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah. Well I thought it was interesting what you said this morning before we started interviewing about Bird that people had that perception of him, you know that he was kind of crazy, but actually…

Not at all. It was just he opposite. And there are a few sessions where you could hear Bird speak. And that’s a tip off, to hear him speak. Even as opposed to Dizzy at the same time, where Dizzy was all hip talking silly and, Bird was really very reserved and well spoken.
Intellectual. Pretty near. Of course everything was self-taught. He didn’t go to any universities to become what he did. He had a fantastic brain.
